The Auction Arena desktop app for macOS, Windows and Linux.

### Which file do I download?

- **Mac with an Apple chip** (M1, M2, M3, M4): [Auction-Arena-{version}-mac-arm64.dmg](https://github.com/{repo}/releases/download/v{version}/Auction-Arena-{version}-mac-arm64.dmg)
- **Mac with an Intel chip:** [Auction-Arena-{version}-mac-x64.dmg](https://github.com/{repo}/releases/download/v{version}/Auction-Arena-{version}-mac-x64.dmg)
- **Windows:** [Auction-Arena-{version}-win-x64.exe](https://github.com/{repo}/releases/download/v{version}/Auction-Arena-{version}-win-x64.exe)
- **Linux:** [Auction-Arena-{version}-linux-x86_64.AppImage](https://github.com/{repo}/releases/download/v{version}/Auction-Arena-{version}-linux-x86_64.AppImage) (runs without installing) or [Auction-Arena-{version}-linux-amd64.deb](https://github.com/{repo}/releases/download/v{version}/Auction-Arena-{version}-linux-amd64.deb) (Ubuntu and Debian)

Not sure which Mac you have? Apple menu > About This Mac > Chip. You can ignore the `.blockmap` and `.yml` files: the installed app uses them to check for updates.

### First launch

The app is free and not signed by Apple or Microsoft, so the first launch needs one extra step:

- **macOS:** open the `.dmg`, drag Auction Arena into Applications and open it. When macOS blocks it, click Done, then open System Settings > Privacy & Security and click **Open Anyway**.
- **Windows:** when "Windows protected your PC" appears, click **More info > Run anyway**.
